firstMaterialDivergence: adapter.ts applies mutations from every event in the stream instead of selecting and materializing only the numerically greatest complete valid epoch.

evidenceAssessments.reason: The timely authoritative contract identifies the field that scopes epoch state.
The timely authoritative contract identifies the ordering field used to validate and apply an epoch.
The contract identifies BEGIN as the epoch-start marker.
The contract identifies COMMIT as the epoch-completion marker.
The contract identifies UPSERT and DELETE as the mutation kinds permitted between epoch boundaries.
The contract requires key-ascending output order.

preservedInvariants: State from different epochs is never combined
Only one complete valid epoch is materialized
Deletes and later key reuse are interpreted inside the selected epoch
summary: The authoritative, timely contract and policy establish an adapter defect: materialization leaks state across epochs and does not reject streams without a complete valid epoch. The repair validates a unique contiguous sequence with boundary markers only at its ends, selects the greatest valid epoch, and applies it from empty state.
